findings.title: Revisions and other core-group kinds have no category, but health rules, Needs attention and drawer classification depend on one
findings.location: B.6 rule 4, B.4.1 item 4, B.9 Drawer data flow, B.10
findings.fix: Add 'packageRevision' and 'compositionRevision' to CROSSPLANE_CATEGORIES. Map deriveHealth rules to them. Add RevisionRow extends CrossplaneRowBase, replacing PackageRevisionSummary. Define NeedsAttentionRow = CrossplaneRowBase. classifyCrossplaneObject returns null for other core-group kinds (MRD, ImageConfig, Lock), and the drawer falls back to generic sections, not 'managed'. Add tests.

findings.title: Per-category drawer sections and name-only reference resolution are unspecified
findings.fix: Add a 'Drawer sections per category' table listing sections, clickable refs and apiVersion resolution: kindVersions for core refs; providerConfigRef resolved via the getPackages providerConfig rows matched by providerName, kind and name; compositeTypeRef resolved to the XRD; Usage resourceSelector shown as text. Build all links with a tested pure resolveDrawerRefs() helper. Secret refs and refs that fail refSchema render as text, not links.

findings.title: scanManaged's kind-index dependency and force/in-flight semantics are implicit
findings.location: B.5 MR scan and items, cache table
findings.fix: scanManaged always calls getManagedKinds(ctx, {force:false}). force on scanManaged bypasses only the scan-summary cache. force skips the cached value but joins any in-flight promise for the same key.

findings.title: Small conflicts and unspecified UI behaviour
findings.location: AC 4 vs B.5 200 cap, B.4.1 warning events, B.4 healthColumn JSX vs createElement, AC 22 column list
findings.fix: Reword AC 4 for the 200-item MR cap and add a '+N more' footer. Clicking a Warning event opens the drawer when toCrossplaneRef(involvedObject) parses. Show healthColumn in createElement form. Add Running, Count and Deps to AC 22.

findings.title: Definitions view refreshes full composites snapshots only for instance counts
findings.fix: Use minIntervalMs 120_000 for composites in the Definitions view. Optionally raise the composites TTL to 30 s when there are more than 20 XR+claim sections.

findings.title: useResourceSorting extraction wording
findings.fix: Keep the returned property name getSortedData and the special-key order before the numeric branch. No Crossplane column may use dataKey 'status' or 'replicas'.
